content.short: Pheasant Network is an Intent-centric Bridge and Cross-chain Swap.
content.description: Pheasant Network employs intent-based bridging together with an advanced cross-chain swap protocol to connect 30+ blockchain networks with speed and efficiency. By uniting fragmented blockchain ecosystems while preserving security, it reduces cross-chain friction and enhances overall interoperability. This design enables smoother, more reliable cross-chain interactions for assets and data, helping developers and users navigate multi-chain environments without sacrificing safety or performance, and it supports growth across diverse networks.
content.meta: Pheasant Network offers intent-centric bridging and cross-chain swaps for digital assets. Discover Pheasant Network and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
